facts.fact: 她在午夜浴缸里念 Florescentia，沉入水下进入彼界。
facts.anchor: The water portal worked for Altair

facts.fact: 浴室变成浅水，长出水草与发光小鱼。
彼界花朵里有嘴，植物长出牙齿与眼睛。
Altair 警告水中旅行危险，可能淹死。
facts.anchor: Traveling by water can be treacherous

facts.fact: 它说选择 Dorian 的形象是因为「最有利的联想」。
facts.anchor: the image with the most favorable connotation

facts.fact: 它说真身会让她精神崩溃。

facts.anchor: Would you prefer a different taste?

facts.fact: 它警告越互动越可能被彼界整个带走。
facts.anchor: the higher the risk it will take you altogether

facts.fact: 它说她的规则在彼界不管用。
它说被彼界抓住会被当成能量来源养着。
它把她送回图书馆，说咒语只在造就她的世界有效。
facts.anchor: Your incantations only work in the world that made you
